title: Orvellaine Font
author: Retro
description:
ORVELLAINE – Elegant Luxury Serif Font
ORVELLAINE is an elegant high-contrast serif display font created for sophisticated and timeless designs. Its refined thick-and-thin strokes, graceful curves, and luxurious editorial character make it an excellent choice for premium branding and elegant visual projects.
Perfect for luxury logos, fashion branding, wedding invitations, beauty products, perfume packaging, editorial designs, stationery, social media graphics, posters, and more.
Perfect For:
Luxury Branding
Fashion & Editorial Design
Wedding Invitations
Beauty & Cosmetics
Perfume & Fragrance Packaging
Logo Design
Boutique Branding
Stationery
Posters & Headlines
Social Media Designs
Product Packaging
Elegant Typography
File Type: OTF Only
ORVELLAINE brings a sophisticated, romantic, and premium touch to every design, making it an ideal choice for designers who want an elegant and distinctive serif aesthetic.
